title: SLO-aware traffic escrow ramps with feature-flagged canary divergence mitigation
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Background: We need a more robust progressive delivery primitive that reduces noisy rollouts and improves rollback precision. Current percent-ramp canaries expose users to brief SLO regressions or noisy signal due to low sample counts. Proposal summary: Implement a traffic escrow ramp mode that holds a candidate fraction of traffic in a validation escrow rather than immediately exposing it. Traffic in escrow is shadowed to the candidate variant and evaluated against production using a divergence score and SLO accumulators. Only when escrow metrics (latency, error-rate, quality regressions) are within configurable tolerances for a stability window is traffic released to live. Combine this with feature-flag gating and an automated rollback policy for fast failure paths.
